posts.description: There is nothing simultaneously more noble and ignoble in Irish Traditional Music than what I call, “The Participation Prize in Irish Music.” I assert there’s nothing more noble in Irish music, because this is how all of us get a start. posts.title: No One Really Wants Your Pity
posts.description: In the same way that almost no one really wants take revenge, no one who’s thought it all the way through really wants your pity. On the other hand, I think a lot of people think they want to give pity. Both ends of this exchange are only empty forms of self aggrandizement. Pity, like anger, is only a first step.
